intro.text: The head steward of Citylord Roshone in Hearthstone.

items.text: Natir came from Dalilak in the far north of Alethkar, and is married to a stern-looking woman named Alaxia.
After Miliv's death, Natir was hired as head steward to Roshone, Hearthstone's new citylord.
Natir was there when Amaram came to Hearthstone to recruit soldiers.

appearance.text: Tall, with slender hands; he wears a long black coat and a purple cravat.
